packages.title: Greenhouse gas reporting conversion factors 2026 — revision and parcel guard QA
facts: No parcel greenhouse-gas value is produced without valid activity data, an accepted method and parcel binding.
DESNZ published greenhouse-gas reporting conversion factors for 2026 on 11 June 2026.
The factors are intended to help users calculate and report greenhouse-gas emissions from UK activities in 2026.
The page distinguishes activity-based conversion factors from Defra spend-based emissions multipliers.
Conversion factors are coefficients and are not direct measurements of emissions from a cadastral parcel.

packages.title: ONS UK Environmental Accounts: 2026 — scope and status QA
facts: ONS released UK Environmental Accounts: 2026 on 5 June 2026.
The bulletin estimates 478 million tonnes of greenhouse gases on a residence basis in 2024.
Residence-basis emissions include UK residents and UK-registered businesses wherever they operate.
Residence-basis national accounts emissions are not direct measurements for individual cadastral parcels.
No parcel greenhouse-gas value is inferred from the UK Environmental Accounts bulletin.

packages.title: ONS UK Environmental Accounts: 2026 release and datasets — scope and status QA
facts: The ONS UK Environmental Accounts 2026 release page is dated 5 June 2026.
The release links the bulletin and environmental-account datasets including energy-use and atmospheric-emission tables.
Dataset scope, reference period and accounting basis must be preserved when combining release components.
A release catalogue does not itself provide a parcel greenhouse-gas measurement.

packages.title: ONS Measuring UK greenhouse gas emissions — scope and status QA
facts: ONS revised its Measuring UK greenhouse gas emissions methodology on 7 July 2026.
The methodology distinguishes territorial, residence or production, and footprint or consumption measures.
It gives an estimated 367 MtCO2e for UK territorial emissions in 2025 and a provisional 478 MtCO2e for production emissions in 2024.
Different accounting bases must not be mixed or converted into parcel-level measurements without a separate method.
No cadastral parcel value is inferred from national accounting-basis totals.

packages.title: ONS Atmospheric emissions: greenhouse gases by industry and gas — current — scope and status QA
facts: The current ONS atmospheric greenhouse-gas dataset was released on 5 June 2026 and covers 1990 to 2024.
It reports carbon dioxide, methane, nitrous oxide, HFCs, PFCs, sulphur hexafluoride, nitrogen trifluoride and total greenhouse gases by industry.
The current edition provides data across detailed economic sectors and includes revision history.
Industry-account emissions are not direct cadastral parcel measurements.
No parcel greenhouse-gas value is inferred from industry-level environmental accounts.

packages.title: ONS Atmospheric emissions: greenhouse gases by industry and gas — provisional — scope and status QA
facts: The provisional ONS atmospheric greenhouse-gas dataset is part of the 5 June 2026 release and covers 1990 to 2024.
ONS states that the provisional edition provides top-level estimates, while the current edition provides all economic sectors.
Provisional status must be retained and must not be silently treated as final or as the detailed current edition.
Top-level provisional emissions are not measurements for individual land parcels.
No parcel greenhouse-gas value is inferred from the provisional dataset.
